name: Tajik National Park (Mountains of the Pamirs)
description: Tajik National Park fills a vast stretch of eastern Tajikistan, where the Pamir mountains meet other great Eurasian ranges. Its high, windswept plateaus give way to peaks above 7,000 metres, and it holds 1,085 glaciers, including the longest valley glacier outside the polar regions. Over 400 lakes dot the park, and snow leopards and Marco Polo sheep roam its remote, barely settled landscape.
